title: Batch launcher hardcodes pwsh without PS5.1 fallback
description: Windows launcher scripts that call pwsh directly can fail on hosts where PowerShell 7 is missing, even though PS5.1-compatible fallback exists. This causes avoidable startup failures across mixed fleets.
detection_method: Regex scan for batch files invoking pwsh without a preceding where/if fallback assignment to powershell.exe
preventionRule: In batch launchers, resolve pwsh first and fallback to powershell.exe when unavailable.
remedy: Add fallback guard: set PWSH_EXE=pwsh.exe; where pwsh.exe >nul 2>&1; if errorlevel 1 set PWSH_EXE=powershell.exe; then invoke %PWSH_EXE% consistently.
